title: Tree Hover Action
description: A FlatLaf JTree with hover action icons on each row, inline rename editing, and drag-and-drop reordering.

title: Skeleton
description: A JLayer LayerUI that shows shimmering loading placeholders shaped from the real components, and blocks input while loading.

title: Badge Notification
description: An animated notification badge that decorates any component through a JLayer, with counts, text or dots, any corner, and an alert animation.

title: Loading
description: Animated loading indicators as plain Swing icons, with 27 built-in styles, custom painters, size presets and theme colors, and no start or stop calls.

title: Switch Button
description: An animated switch icon for JCheckBox or JToggleButton, with 8 styles, theme-aware colors, any size, and FlatLaf style strings.

title: Help Tooltip
description: A rich tooltip for any JComponent, ported from IntelliJ, with a title, shortcut, HTML description and link, smart width, and theme-aware colors.

title: Liquid Progress Indicator
description: A progress component that fills circles, gauges, batteries, flasks and more with animated liquid, with dual waves, rising bubbles, two-tone text, and theme-aware colors.

title: QR Code Generator
description: A QR code component with 12 body shapes, custom eye frames and balls, gradients, a center logo, and PNG or SVG export, with a headless API for servers.
